name: Workshop Practice & Hand Tools
summary: Hands-on workshop skills: safe use of measuring instruments, hand and power tools, basic machine tools, sheet metal and fastening.

topics.name: Workshop safety, PPE and risk awareness
Measuring and marking out: rules, squares, scribers, height gauges, surface plates
Hand tools: files, hacksaws, chisels, hammers, wrenches and screwdrivers
Drilling, reaming, countersinking and hand tapping/threading
Power tools: drills, angle grinders, band saws and bench grinders
Introduction to the manual lathe (facing, turning, drilling, threading)
Introduction to the manual milling machine (squaring, slots, pockets)
Fasteners, threads and torque tightening in practice
Workholding: vises, clamps, V-blocks and simple fixtures
Fitting, deburring and finishing by hand
Maker tools: desktop 3D printers, laser cutters and CNC routers
